name: GM CCA - Charlotte Parts Distribution Center, Charlotte NC

fieldNotes.facility: Positively identified as GM Customer Care & Aftersales (CCA) Charlotte Parts Distribution Center, 10815 Quality Dr, Charlotte NC 28278 (Steele Creek). ROOFTOP geocode 35.1391925,-80.9879849. Web-confirmed: 352,000 sq ft, opened 1999, ships ~420,000 customer orders/month; GM announced a $23M modernization investment in 2024. Note the prompt's 28269 zip was wrong - correct zip is 28278.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence rings the truck-yard side of the building. 2022/2019 Street View shows a sliding gate across the driveway where it leaves the office/employee-parking area and enters the fenced truck court. The truck yard itself (SE/shared court) is reached through this controlled fence line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the gate in Street View or in z20 satellite (no separate booth footprint beside the lane). Office front is open employee parking; the truck-side gate is unmanned-appearing. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no confirmed booth -> set true (kiosk/badge/remote check-in implied) at low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks on BOTH long faces of the building: the NW face (with a drop-trailer row + trailers backed in) and the SE face (trailers backed in along the shared court). ~30-35 doors per face, ~65 total -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop row along the NW apron plus a large shared trailer court on the SE side between GM and the neighboring warehouse; ~50 trailers visible -> 25-50 band (borderline 50+, called 25-50 conservatively).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Yes - a dedicated trailer-storage row on the NW apron and a sizeable SE trailer court hold dropped trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock-style layout with dock banks on two physically separate (NW and SE) building faces, each with its own truck court -> ship/receive can run from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single controlled site access off Quality Dr feeding the office area and the gated truck court; trucks enter and exit through the same gate group.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck courts inside the fence on both the NW and SE faces give ample post-gate holding before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal driveway/court from the gate to the dock faces holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and deep truck courts leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line (CSX-type, rail cars + a locomotive present) runs along the SW edge in the treed buffer OUTSIDE the property; it does NOT spur into the GM building. The PDC is truck-served. Set false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Steele Creek industrial/logistics park in southwest Charlotte metro, surrounded by other large warehouses -> Urban.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~90 estimate combining the NW drop row and SE court; overhead estimate, flagged.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~22 acres for the building (~352k sq ft footprint), two truck courts, office/employee parking, and the treed buffer inside the perimeter (derived from the perimeter polygon).
